stages.name: Minimum efficient scale
stages.title: Minimum efficient scale
stages.sub: The smallest output a firm needs to reach the lowest point of average cost.

steps.q: A firm grows output. At first average cost falls (economies of scale), but eventually it would rise again (diseconomies of scale). Between these two, is there a stretch of output where average cost is doing neither?
steps.right: Yes, it can stay flat for a while
steps.wrong: No, it must always be rising or falling
steps.hint: Falling then rising does not have to happen with no gap in between. Could there be a middle stretch?
